newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies 13 municipal issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies 13 municipal issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 13 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Dryden Central School District, N.Y., $12.25 million general obligation bonds.
--Oneonta City School District, N.Y., $6.663 million bonds.
--Simpson County, Miss., $2.250 million road and bridge GOs.
--University of North Texas Board of Regent, $8.230 million refunding revenue bonds.
--Wyandanch, N.Y., USFD, $11.08 million school district GOs.
--McKinney, Texas, $1 million tax and revenue bonds, $1.910 million revs and $1.750 million waste water and sewer bonds.
--Coahoma County S.D., Miss., $6.5 million school GOs.
